_doc: Alert-name -> Grafana panel coordinates (DEMO-8 / #60). Loaded by agents.auto_ticketing on every ticket-create attempt; failure to render or attach the panel must NOT break ticket creation. Keys are Prometheus alert rule names (the `alert` field from demo/scenarios/*.yaml). Keys starting with `_` are reserved for documentation entries like this one and are filtered out at load time. Add entries here when wiring a new scenario whose Grafana view is worth attaching. `dashboard_uid` is the stable id from the dashboard's URL (.../d/<UID>/...); `panel_id` is the numeric id shown when 'Inspect -> Panel JSON' on that panel. `time_range` is a single relative window (e.g. `15m`, `6h`) that the renderer expands to Grafana's from=now-<range> / to=now.
_verify: TODO post-merge (#60 follow-up): the `dashboard_uid` and `panel_id` values below are placeholders that haven't been validated against a running Grafana yet. A wrong UID surfaces as a silent 'no panel mapped' or a 404 from the renderer — neither breaks ticket creation, but neither produces an attachment. Verify against the OTel demo's Grafana once the grafana-image-renderer plugin is enabled on the cluster.
